text:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High 5xx and timeouts observed on runtime-api/service=model-runner. Severity: P1. Start=2026-03-14T13:46:29Z. Current 5xx rate=15% (baseline 0.4%). See dashboards: https://metrics.redwood/runtime/errors and recent logs: https://logs.redwood/model-runner?q=segfault

anu (oncall): I'm on it. Paging runtime + infra. @leo @maria please triage. Any recent rollouts?

leo (ml-runtime): Seeing repeated "segfault" and OOM kill messages across several pods. Sample from model-runner-7f4b: 
```
2026-03-14T13:45:58Z [runner] fatal: signal 11 (Segmentation fault)
stack trace: ...
[kernel] Out of memory: Kill process 4122 (model-runner) total-vm: 14G, anon-rss: 12G
```
Memory use spikes align with batch size spikes. We merged a change to the allocation/kv eviction code ~35m ago (commit: 2a7e9c).

maria (infra): No host kernel or driver upgrades in last 3h. We do have an image rollout for model-runner starting 13:10Z (tag: release-2a7e9c). Recommendation: pause rollout and revert to previous image while we mitigate. Also add node-level oom logs.

ida (sre): Immediate mitigation options:
- rollback deployment to previous stable image
- reduce runtime batch_size and disable continuous batching globally for runtime-api
- shift a portion of traffic to quantized-small model pool as fallback (route 30%)
- cordon nodes with heavy OOM activity and redeploy elsewhere
Commands to run: 
```bash
kubectl get deploy model-runner -o yaml | yq .spec.template.spec.containers[0].image
kubectl rollout undo deployment/model-runner --to-revision=1
kubectl set env deploy/runtime-api BATCHING_ENABLED=false --namespace=prod
```
I'll start routing rules change if we decide.

leo (ml-runtime): Agree. Also we should capture a core and nvprof on one crashed instance for postmortem. Steps: 
```bash
# on pod
pid=$(pgrep model-runner) || true
if [ -n "$pid" ]; then gcore -o /tmp/core.$pid $pid; pmap $pid > /tmp/pmap.$pid; fi
# copy out
kubectl cp $pod:/tmp/core.$pid ./
```
Note: gcore might not exist in slim image; we may need a debug image.

anu (oncall): Rolling back now. @release-bot initiate rollback to previous stable tag. Also enabling emergency routing: runtime-api -> small-quantized for 20m.

release-bot: Rollback kickoff: deployment/model-runner -> rollback to revision 1. Started 2026-03-14T13:50:12Z.

release-bot: Rollback finished. New pods using image release-2a7e9c-prev. Health checks: passing 85%, failing=2 pods still restarting.

maria (infra): Cordon+draining nodes with persistent oom: node-4 and node-9. Scaling nodepool +1 g4dn; expect ~5m. Also attaching dmesg from node-9: "Out of memory: Killed process 4122 (model-runner)".

jamal (support): Impact update: ~520 requests/min affected, 5 customers showing visible errors. Notifying affected accounts and updating status page. Draft message: "We are aware of 5xx errors affecting inference requests. Our engineers are actively mitigating; a rollback has been performed."

ida (sre): After rollback + routing, 5xx down to ~1.8%. Some pods still show restarts due to leftover bad cache in persistent volumes. Plan: clear cache on restart for model-runner pods. Command: `kubectl delete pvc model-runner-cache-<id>` or mount ephemeral tmpfs for cache.

leo (ml-runtime): Collected artifacts from one pod and uploaded to s3://redwood-incidents/1795236789/artifacts.tgz. Early heap diff shows KV cache not evicting under high batch_size; allocation pattern changed in commit 2a7e9c. Putting together a bisect plan between commits 2a7e9c and previous.

maria (infra): New node added; no new OOMs observed on new capacity. Drains completed on cordoned nodes.

anu (oncall): Monitoring window 30m started. Will keep this page open until stable for 30m. Please add any follow-ups to INC-2026-1795236789.

ida (sre): Post-incident follow-ups to create:
- Root cause analysis (KV eviction bug) 8h owner: leo
- Add stricter container memory limits and OOM alerting owner: maria
- Improve canary gating for runtime image owner: release-eng
- Add automated garbage collection/instrumentation for KV cache owner: leo

jamal (support): Status updated: "Service degraded between 13:46-14:05 UTC due to a runtime regression causing OOM/segfaults. We performed a rollback; normal operations restored. We're continuing investigations; no customer data loss reported."

leo (ml-runtime): Will start bisect tomorrow and aim to have a patch for eviction as a hotfix. Uploaded pmap, core, and logs: s3://redwood-incidents/1795236789/artifacts/

anu (oncall): After 30m monitoring, error rate steady at baseline. Closing live incident channel. Assigning owners: leo (root cause), maria (infra remediation), release-eng (canary). Handing off to @nora (next oncall) for PM follow-ups. Thread resolved 2026-03-14T14:07:22Z. Thanks everyone.
